Threat report: M-PESA phishing campaign

Warning: this advisory documents a phishing campaign. Do not visit these sites. Never enter a PIN on them.

Indicators of compromise

  • Domain: mpesa-verify-example[.]test
  • WhatsApp: +254 700 000 099 used for "customer support" in the lures
  • Telegram: @mpesa_help_fake (Telegram channel)
  • BTC wallet address: bc1qxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxx
  • Paybill 123456 quoted in victim messages

The lures say "verify your account" and "enter your OTP".
